items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: So I left and finally, she got a good saxophone player that, you know, that was a regular, Taft Jordan and Tyree was in the band, Tyree Glenn.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. He married Sy's sister. So all those cats was -- they said, "Yeah, man, hell, yeah, we want this gig." So I got them and I worked down Savannah Club like all -- up until Thursdays and on Thursdays, I would leave and come on in and play the Celebrity Club. We, you know, we'd

rehearse and rehearse and rehearse and getting the band in shape and I stayed down there until -- I would send guys down there, man, and I'd send so many guys down there that couldn't read, hell of a players, but when they'd get down there to play them damn shows, they couldn't read. So Lucille says, -- she was so nice -- she says, "Yeah, he could play, but he just couldn't cut the music." So I says, "Lucille, it really isn't fair to you." I stayed down there a long time with her. I says, "I think I'm going to…
